title: Yellowed Flaky Irish Potato Grill
description: A midnight craving Irish dish featuring truffle oil and deglaze fond, this recipe is a umami and flaky delight, perfect for a snack, made in a raclette grill and nut free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the Irish potatoes into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
In a bowl, mix together minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced potatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the garlic mixture.
Place the potato slices on the raclette grill and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and flaky.
While the potatoes are cooking, mix the truffle oil and deglaze fond in a small bowl.
Once the potatoes are done, brush them with the truffle oil mixture.
Top each potato slice with shaved Grana padano cheese and return to the grill for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the potatoes from the grill and top with chopped fresh parsley and a pat of butter.
